metadata.title: Multi-Class Fruit, Vegetable and Agricultural Object Detection Dataset
metadata.description:
The dataset contains a total of 28,139 images (and 261,631 annotations), which were divided into three subsets: 22,334 for training, 3,672 for validation and 2,133 images for testing. 

The dataset is composed of the following datasets publicly available on the Roboflow platform:
